name: species_traits
title: Species-level trait observations
description: Long format: one row per species x trait. Long rather than wide because most traits apply to only one lineage (leaf traits to plants, haplodiploidy to animals) — a wide table would be mostly empty cells and would not distinguish 'not applicable' from 'not scored'. Absence of a row means the trait was not scored for that species; it never means a negative observation.

fields.name: ott_id
fields.description: Open Tree taxon id. Joins to species.csv.

fields.name: value
fields.description: Trait value. Categorical values are drawn from trait_vocabularies.csv; booleans are true/false; numeric values are stored as strings and cast on read.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Where the value came from. New submissions must name their own source.

fields.name: source_citation
fields.description: Primary literature citation for this specific value, where the upstream database recorded one. 163 values carry one.

fields.name: flag_cross_checked
fields.description: TRUE where the value has an independent primary citation from the Tree of Sex database.
